rule: Newest first-parent fix-like commits with 1–120 production code lines, <=250 total lines, <=10 files, clean full reverse application at fixed base. Manually validate bug semantics before freezing 15; exclude feature/typing-only changes.

cases.subject: fix: skip inject_event when inject flow type is wrong (#8141)
cases.target: Invalid/non-protocol flow input must return after warning instead of constructing/injecting events and crashing.

cases.subject: fix a flow reader bug found with fuzzing (#7841)
cases.target: Non-dictionary tnetstring flow data must produce FlowReadException rather than escaping with wrong-type errors.

cases.subject: fix #7452 (#7666)
cases.target: HAR request bodySize must use raw bytes; decoding malformed/compressed content can crash export and gives wrong wire size.

cases.subject: fixup url.unparse (#7624)
cases.target: url.unparse must preserve byte inputs as bytes instead of formatting bytes repr into a string; Request URL still handles asterisk targets.

cases.subject: Fix error while changing string-based options (#7183)
cases.target: String option editor must unwrap AttrMap before get_text; wrapper has no get_text and editing crashes.

cases.subject: Do not block local mode connections (#7036)
cases.target: Local proxy connections must bypass block_global/block_private even when peer address is non-loopback.

cases.subject: Fix decompressing fake pointers in DNS messages (#7022)
cases.target: A DNS RDATA byte with 0b11 high bits may be ordinary data, not a valid pointer; catch struct.error and preserve bytes.

cases.subject: Fix certs for unicode domains (#6796)
cases.target: Unicode hostnames must be IDNA-encoded before x509.DNSName, which rejects Unicode strings.

cases.subject: Fix Bug view options menu (#6697)
cases.target: View options dropdown can overflow/clamp outside short flow detail; preserve max-height and scrolling.

cases.subject: web: don't crash when opening options (#6386)
cases.target: SaveHar option help must be one string, not a positional choices string that causes options UI to crash.

cases.subject: Command signature inspection fix (#6029) (#6032)
cases.target: Command signature inspection must evaluate postponed string annotations to resolve command argument types.

cases.subject: fix #5972 (#5982)
cases.target: Forced HTTP next layer in upstream proxy mode must retain HTTPMode.upstream so requests use the configured upstream.

cases.subject: fix a race condition in `ConnectionHandler.drain_writers` (#5749)
cases.target: Snapshot transport values before awaiting drain; concurrent connection removal mutates dictionary during iteration.

cases.subject: remove overambitious assertion found with fuzzing, fix #5343 (#5352)
cases.target: Late data for an already-removed HTTP stream is allowed and must not assert that only protocol errors can arrive.

cases.subject: Fixes AttributeError in transparent mode (#4951)
cases.target: Windows transparent Resolver must catch uninitialized wfile AttributeError and connect/retry on first use.

excluded.7905: Python 3.14 SyntaxWarning cleanup; exclude from behavior-bug cohort before model results.
